releases.title: Conversations fit the screen
fixes: In a conversation, a long item title made the whole page wider than the screen, so your own messages ran off the right edge: the title now wraps and every message stays inside, long words and links included

releases.title: Lighter on memory, and back if the screen drops
changes: Thumbnails go to Vintly's screen once; every later update refers to them by key (an update went from about 1–1.4 MB, sent dozens of times while preparing, to about 15 KB)
If WebKit drops Vintly's screen (it does when memory runs low), Vintly notices within 15 s, builds the screen again and hands everything over, instead of leaving it empty or frozen
The detailed log notes when Vintly goes to the background and comes back, and leaves a "still open" mark after a quiet minute, so the time it stopped shows
A run that iOS ended while Vintly was in the background is no longer reported as "didn't close normally"
The barcode close-up read by AI is counted as Reading barcodes up close in Token usage (it showed as a second listing request)
Tests: tests/cases/07-page-state.test.js
fixes: Messages and your listings could fail to load just after opening ("Load failed") when the network wasn't up yet: they now try once more

releases.title: A log to catch the crash

highlights.title: Detailed log
highlights.text: Every step, with times and sizes, saved on your iPhone so the moment before a crash is kept.

highlights.title: Copy it in one tap
highlights.text: Settings › Diagnostics › Copy: this run and the one before, ready to paste.

highlights.title: Knows when it crashed
highlights.text: If Vintly didn't close normally, the next start says so and shows its last steps.

changes: Settings › Diagnostics › Detailed log (on for now): start-up, every message from the page, every page job (photo scaling, barcode scanning, stickers, cut-outs) with its size and time, AI and Vinted requests, preparing and posting steps, how much state goes to the page, and errors with their stack, in vintly-trace.log on this iPhone (not iCloud)
Lines before heavy work are saved at once, so the last line before a crash is on disk; each start keeps the run before as vintly-trace-prev.log
A run that didn't end with a normal close is noted on the next start, on the To post list, with its last steps, Copy the log and Dismiss

Copy the log (Settings, the note, and the "Vintly couldn't open" screen) puts this run and the one before on the clipboard, with the version, iPhone, iOS and a few settings; Show the latest steps; Clear
The page's own errors and each time it starts are written down; every 15 s Vintly checks the page still answers, and notes when it doesn't (WebKit drops a page that runs out of memory)
Barcode scanning uses far less of WebKit's memory: one canvas per grid of tiles, reused and let go at once, tiles at most 1600 px (was a new 2048 px canvas for each of about 35 tiles per photo)
Tests: tests/cases/06-trace.test.js
fixes: To post with no items didn't show notes above it

releases.title: Sorting that doesn't trip
changes: Every AI answer is read forgivingly: JSON inside other text (even text with braces of its own), keys without quotes, 'single quotes', comments, trailing commas, curly quotes, and answers cut off at the end
Sorting photos: more room for the answer with many photos, OpenAI's JSON mode, one more try when an answer can't be read, and the answer written to the start log for help
Listings from photos also ask OpenAI for JSON only
Tests: tests/cases/05-sort-reply.test.js
fixes: Sorting several photos could fail with "JSON Parse error: Property name must be a string literal" when AI wrote a sentence with braces before its answer; when it still can't sort, it now says so in plain words

releases.title: See every photo large

highlights.title: Photos, large
highlights.text: Tap any photo you took to see it full screen; swipe through the rest.

highlights.title: Remove from the session
highlights.text: Drop a photo you don't want before the items are made, or move it to another item.

highlights.title: Neater cards
highlights.text: The ready and needs-a-look signs sit cleanly on the photo, and the scan stays inside it.

changes: Photo viewer: tap a photo in the camera tray, in New photos or in an item to see it full screen (at full size), with ‹ › and swipe to go through them
In the viewer: remove the photo (two taps) from the photo session, from New photos or from the item; in New photos also move it to another item or a new one
The camera tray shows the photos taken so far as small thumbnails
New photos: a tap on a photo opens it (moving is in the viewer), the hint says so
The ✓ and ! signs on a card are drawn icons on the front photo's top-right corner, with a ring in the card's colour, instead of overlapping the card's edge
The scan line and glow while a photo is worked on stay inside the photo's rounded frame, never over the buttons under it
Tests: tests/cases/04-photo-viewer.test.js
fixes: The scan effect on a photo ran past its edges onto the buttons below and was cut off at the top
The ready sign on a card covered the photo and the card's border

releases.title: Barcodes that read, posts in line

highlights.title: Barcodes that read
highlights.text: A real barcode reader scans the stripes, zooms in where AI saw the code, and checks every digit.

highlights.title: Two at a time
highlights.text: A pile of items is prepared two at once, so the list is ready sooner.

highlights.title: Posts in line
highlights.text: Tap Post on several items: they go to Vinted one by one, in the order you tapped.

changes: Barcodes: ZXing (the open-source barcode reader, version 0.21.3, its SHA-256 checked) is downloaded once and reads the stripes of the original photos in overlapping tiles while ✦ AI reads the photos; when AI points out a barcode it couldn't be read from, a zoomed, sharpened crop of that spot is scanned, and then given to ✦ AI to read the digits; digits AI reads count only when the barcode's check digit is right
The item says how its barcode was found (scanned, scanned up close, read by AI); when one is in the photos but can't be read, the card and the item say a sharp close-up helps
Photo size kept: 2048 px by default (was 1600), so labels and barcodes stay sharp
Titles always start with a capital letter: AI's, typed ones, fixes and titles saved before; each part of a two-language title gets its own; words like iPhone or eBay stay as made
Settings › AI › Items prepared at once (2 by default, 1 to 4); the bar shows the items being prepared now
Posting goes one item at a time: further Post taps wait in line (Waiting to post · 2), with Don't post to take one out
Tests: tests/cases/03-line-titles.test.js
fixes: A barcode digit misread by AI could look up the wrong product

releases.title: Errors you can read, and fix with one tap

highlights.title: Fix with AI
highlights.text: One tap sends the error to AI, which changes what Vinted didn't accept; then post again.

highlights.title: Errors in plain words
highlights.text: Every error says what went wrong and what would fix it; Vinted's own answer waits under Details.

highlights.title: Progress where you tap
highlights.text: Posting fills the Post button itself; the screen never jumps or scrolls.

changes: Posting, saving a draft and fixing show their progress in place of their own button: one line and a bar, always the same height; the growing step list at the top of the item is gone for them, and preparing's list shows its last four steps
Errors show next to the button that failed (Post errors above Post, now Post again) and the sheet no longer scrolls to them

✦ AI writes every error in plain words (title and one or two sentences) on the card and in the item, and says whether changing the listing could fix it; errors saved earlier are explained when Vintly opens

✦ Fix with AI, in the error and on the card (also for fields still needed): the error, Vinted's answer, the listing and every choice Vinted offers go to the AI, which changes title, description, price, category, brand, condition, size and other fields, colours or parcel; each change is checked against Vinted's lists, a new category gets a second round for its fields, and what changed is listed (✦ Fixed by …)
Settings › AI settings › Token usage counts Explaining and fixing errors on its own
Tests: tests/cases/02-errors-fix.test.js
fixes: Parcel sizes came in French (Petit, Moyen, Grand): they're now asked for in the Vinted site's language. Items prepared before keep the old names until prepared again or their category changes

releases.title: Snap a pile, post from the list

highlights.title: Prepared one by one
highlights.text: Add photos of several items and each is prepared in turn, while you carry on.

highlights.title: Problems in plain sight
highlights.text: A card with something wrong shows a ⚠ sign and says what, before you open it.

highlights.title: Price and post from the list
highlights.text: Change the price with − and + and tap Post right on the card; Undo for 3 seconds.

changes: New items from a batch are prepared automatically, one at a time, in the order of the batch (Settings › AI settings › Prepare new items right away, on by default); the line is saved and carries on the next time Vintly opens
A bar above the list shows the line (how many done, which one now) with Stop; when nothing is running it offers ✦ Prepare all for items not prepared yet, and counts ready and needs-a-look items

Each card on To post shows its problems: Vinted's refusal or another error, the fields still needed, photos that couldn't be cleaned, and when ✦ AI wasn't sure; a ⚠ or ✓ sign on the photo and a coloured edge
Prepared cards have the price with − and + (by Settings › Pricing › Round prices to), typed prices are saved too, with Vinted's suggested range under it
Post on a card posts after a 3-second count with Undo; cards with something missing get Fix › instead, which opens the item; a failed prepare offers ✦ Try again
Items from a batch keep the batch's order on the list (Item 1 on top)
Tests: the first Vintly scenario, tests/cases/01-batch-list.test.js

releases.title: Built with, explained

highlights.title: Know what's inside
highlights.text: Tap any blueprint in Settings › Built with to see what it is, what it does, what it drives and why it matters.

highlights.title: Works offline
highlights.text: The descriptions come with Vintly, so they open instantly, with or without a connection.

highlights.title: No dead links
highlights.text: Built with no longer sends you to web pages you can't open.

changes: Settings 2.0.1: Settings › Built with opens an About sheet for each blueprint (What it is, What it does, What it drives, Why it matters) from text bundled in the script (BLUEPRINT_ABOUT), plus an About blueprints row; the links to the private blueprints repository are gone
Blueprint trace: Stability patterns 1.0.2, In-app updates 1.1.1, AI configuration 1.0.2, Launch screen 1.0.2, AI invitation 1.2.2, Anonymous usage analytics 1.1.1 (About sections, no code change)
fixes: Tapping a blueprint in Settings › Built with opened a page that no longer exists (404)

releases.title: Ready for the App Store

highlights.title: Ready for the App Store
highlights.text: Built as an app of its own, Vintly gets new versions from the App Store instead of downloading them.

highlights.title: Checked on every change
highlights.text: Every change now runs the shared app tests: start-up, widget, updates and usage counts.

highlights.title: Buttons that work everywhere
highlights.text: Every button in Vintly works the same in Scriptable and as an app of its own.

changes: In-app updates 1.1.0: in a native shell (BuildIt) there is no update check or installer, and Settings › Updates says new versions come through the App Store
Portable bridge recipe: the page hands its messages to window.__hostBridge when a native shell provides one
Testing recipe: the app-blueprints testkit (lint and five conformance packs) runs on every push (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
Blueprint trace: Stability patterns 1.0.1, AI configuration 1.0.1, Launch screen 1.0.1, Widgets 1.1.1

releases.title: Every detail, looked up

highlights.title: Technical details from the web
highlights.text: ✦ AI finds the exact product online: dimensions, weight, materials and specs.

highlights.title: Added to the description
highlights.text: They close the description under a heading, in both your languages.

highlights.title: Barcodes and ISBNs
highlights.text: A code on the item is looked up in free product databases first.

changes: While preparing, ✦ AI looks the item up on the web with your provider's own web search (Claude or OpenAI): the maker's pages first, then big shops and manuals

Up to 10 details for the exact product (or its family, marked “similar model”): dimensions, weight, materials, and what matters for that kind of item, from screen size and battery to pieces and age range
They're added at the end of the description under “Techniniai duomenys / Technical details”; looking up again replaces the block instead of repeating it
A barcode or ISBN that ✦ AI reads in the photos is checked in Open Library or UPCitemdb first (free, no key); without web search those records and the item's own labels are used
The item shows the details, the product found and the sources; if you wrote the description yourself, Add to the description puts them in when you want
Settings › AI settings › What AI does: Look up technical details on the web (on by default). Token usage shows the web searches next to the tokens

releases.title: Pull to refresh

highlights.title: Pull to refresh
highlights.text: Drag the list down from the top to check Vinted for new messages and listing changes.

highlights.title: New messages, right away
highlights.text: The unread count, your conversations and your listings all update in one pull.

highlights.title: Sign-in checked too
highlights.text: If your Vinted session ended, the pull says so instead of showing old numbers.

changes: Pull the main list down from the very top: past the line it says Release to refresh, then a spinner shows while Vintly checks Vinted
One pull refreshes your messages, the unread count and your listings, on any tab; the widget is updated too
If the sign-in is more than an hour old or ended, the pull checks it first and tells you when you need to sign in again
The Refresh buttons stay for when a gesture is awkward

releases.title: See what's happening

highlights.title: Vinted's errors, in full
highlights.text: Each problem Vinted reports, by field, with what it sent back and a copy button.

highlights.title: Watch your photos being scanned
highlights.text: A scan line sweeps over the photo being cleaned, read or uploaded.

highlights.title: A livelier progress bar
highlights.text: It glides as work goes on, with the percentage and the time so far.

changes: When Vinted refuses an item, Vintly lists each problem with the field in plain words (Price, Brand, Manufacturer labelling…), Vinted's own message and code, and the HTTP status
What Vinted sent back and what Vintly sent are one tap away; Copy the details puts it all on the clipboard
A new error scrolls into view by itself, and a short note by the Post button says how many problems there are
While preparing or posting, the photo being worked on is scanned (teal while cleaning, amber while ✦ AI reads, blue while uploading), also in a bigger preview above the bar
The progress bar moves through the whole job (cleaning, reading, Vinted's fields, uploading) with stripes and a glow, its percentage and the seconds so far; item cards show it too
Fixed in testing before release: uploading photos for a post could stop at once

releases.title: Messages, listings and stickers

highlights.title: Vinted messages in Vintly
highlights.text: Unread count on open and on the widget; read and reply right here.

highlights.title: Your listings, with delete
highlights.text: Every listing with views and favourites; delete one with two taps.

highlights.title: Stickers and a QR code
highlights.text: Fun stickers around the item and a Vintly QR code on the main photo.

changes: Messages tab: your Vinted conversations, unread first in the count, loaded every time Vintly opens and every 2 minutes while it's open (Settings › Vinted)
Open a conversation to read it all and reply; it's marked as read on Vinted. If Vinted thinks a reply shares personal details, you can send it anyway
The widget leads with your unread Vinted messages and who wrote (never the messages themselves), then what waits to be posted
On Vinted tab: all your listings, also those posted from the website, with views, favourites, sold, reserved and hidden; open one on Vinted or delete it with two taps
Stickers for kids (all items, kids' items only, or off) around the item on the photos sent to Vinted, never over it; your own photos stay as they are
Vintly's QR code on the main photo, linking to its GitHub page; Vintly makes room under the photo when the item fills the corners. Vinted's rules don't allow links, so it can be turned off
👀 See the photos as buyers will, from any item
Cut-outs keep everything inside the item's outline: screens, prints and dark parts the image model leaves out are filled back in
Fixed: the sign-in check now asks Vinted who you are, so it can't say “signed in” when you aren't

releases.title: Signed in, for real

highlights.title: Vinted sign-in works
highlights.text: After you sign in, Vintly sees it straight away and loads Vinted's fields.

highlights.title: Prepare with AI works
highlights.text: Cleaning photos and filling the listing no longer stop with a JavaScript error.

highlights.title: Clearer messages
highlights.text: If Vinted can't be reached, Vintly says why instead of just “not signed in”.

changes: Fixed: every request to Vinted and every photo cleanup failed on iPhone with “JavaScript execution returned a result of an unsupported type”
Fixed: Vintly said “Not signed in” after a successful sign-in; the check now runs in the page you signed in with
The sign-in and Check messages say what went wrong when the check itself fails

releases.title: Snap it, list it

highlights.title: Photos to listings
highlights.text: Take a few photos of each thing; ✦ AI sorts them and writes every listing.

highlights.title: Clean backgrounds
highlights.text: The background goes and your item keeps its own pixels, on white.

highlights.title: Posted in one tap
highlights.text: Vinted's own fields are filled in; check them, then post or save a draft.

changes: Take photos or choose them (or share them to Vintly from Photos); several items at once
✦ AI sorts a batch of photos into items; move any photo to another item by hand
✦ Photo cleanup with OpenAI's image model: keep the item's own pixels (cut along a drawn mask) or an AI studio photo
✦ Listings from photos with Claude or OpenAI: title and description in two languages (Lithuanian and English by default), with a little humour
Vinted's categories, brands, sizes, conditions, colours, parcel sizes and price suggestions fill the form
A fair price under what similar used items sell for (Settings › Pricing)
Review every field, then post on Vinted or save a Vinted draft; sign in to Vinted inside Vintly
Works without AI: fill in the listing yourself, Vintly still does the Vinted part
Home Screen and Lock Screen widget, launch screen, Settings, in-app updates, opt-in anonymous usage counts (app-blueprints)
